name: Dr. Ambika Rao
summary: Dr. Ambika Rao is a homoeopathic physician with 13 years of experience. Dr. Rao consults at Dr. Neelam Homoeopathic Clinic on Subhash Marg, Mandawa Mod, opposite CKRDM Hospital, Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. Additional qualifications include NDDY, DNHE and a diploma in acupressure. Appointment requests can be made through DOCVY.
